title: Toggle
description: A button that stays pressed — for bold, for pinning, for anything that is a state, not an action.
usage: For state that lives on the button itself: formatting, filters, pins. If pressing it does something and finishes, that is a Button; if it stays down, it is this.
a11y: aria-pressed carries the state, and the pressed style is more than color — weight and fill change too, so the state survives grayscale. Icon- or letter-only toggles need an aria-label (the formatting sample names B/I/U as Bold, Italic, Underline). A disabled toggle is dimmed and does not change. One click flips the state once even if the script loads twice; a bubbling kata-toggle-change event reports detail.pressed. Beta until a recorded screen-reader pass.
